lost_requests_root_causes: There is no complete transfer of instructions from messages to production_board.csv. In 118 manually mapped edit requests, 44 have empty board notes; two voice-note requests and both Instagram edit requests were missed.

The handoff worsens after Zara joins on June 2: all 39 audited, named-title requests for Zara videos are missing board notes, versus 5 of 79 for other editors. This points to an onboarding/handoff/QA gap; it does not establish personal blame.
Requests span email, WhatsApp, voice notes and Instagram, and senders share first names. Resolve identity by full email/phone, client aliases and shoot context; never by first name alone.
Messages saying the one we shot last week omit a video ID/title; three missing requests cannot be assigned to an exact video without an assumption.

Repeat titles across shoots require batch context and version history. Approval is not final forever: Sterling V018 and Evergreen V119 were approved then reopened with new scope. Do not count all revisions as studio mistakes.

Price Insurance Group's September 3 client-wide naming instruction has no durable brand-rule field and was violated again September 10. Spanish requests also need capture: October 2 calmer-song request for Sterling V316 has no board note.

Ask what must change to continue; record the commitment and follow up this week. All outbound contact requires owner approval.

best_marketing_channel.why: Highest observed contribution in the declared first-touch model: $24,000.40 across 6 clients, vs Website form $21,371.80 across 9 and Referral $18,510.60 across 7. Completed booking prices plus May–September retainer invoices, less studio hours at $40/hour and all recorded editor hours at individual pay rates (includes revisions and recorded WIP). Meta also leads average contribution at $4,000.07/client. This is not net profit or acquisition ROI: ad spend, overhead, owner/shoot labor and full lifetime value are missing.

what_this_data_cannot_tell_us: Actual final-video contents, delivery timestamps and whether the missing board instructions were implemented elsewhere; capture gaps are observable, final quality is not.
Whether replies or bank receipts exist outside these exports; a blank reply or missing receipt is an operational warning rather than proof of universal absence.

Cancellation/refund terms or extra cash for Oak Cliff Realty LLC B146 / INV-1135. The client claims prepayment, but available receipts reference other completed services. Hold $1,500 separately as disputed; literal overdue including it is $12,550, confirmed collection queue is $11,050.
The recipient-level split of Northstar September cash: payer-level remainder $900 is supported; FIFO attribution to INV-1131 is provisional, not proof which recipient has not paid.
Whether Keystone extra $900 is refundable, a duplicate, or an agreed future-service deposit; it is an unapplied client credit pending owner decision.
Contracts proving additional retainer months or a Horizon August $250 undercharge. Do not create debt from an assumed uniform monthly price.
Certain original video IDs for three unnamed requests (candidates V101/V124/V224), and a single video for Price's client-wide legal-name requirement.
Causality or personal fault behind the increase in missing handoffs after June. Zara-assigned correlation is not a causal experiment.
Acquisition spend, fixed overhead, sales/shoot labor, taxes/fees, true net profit, causal channel ROI or complete client lifetime value.
Applicant receipt time/deadline, personal identity or a real video recording. Name/email placeholders need replacement.
